models_evaluated: 21 commercial and research AI algorithms for diabetic retinopathy grading (unnamed)

links.outcome: Agreement of 21 AI algorithms with ophthalmologists for referable DR on local prospective data
links.effect: Mean agreement 79.4% (range 49.4% to 92.3%); mean sensitivity 77.5% (95% CI 69.1-85.8), specificity 80.6% (95% CI 72.1-89.2).
links.quote: The performance of the AI algorithms varied considerably emphasizing the need for external validation of screening algorithms in real-world settings before their clinical application.

links.outcome: Variation in performance across competing AI algorithms on the same dataset
links.effect: Agreement for referable DR varied from 49.4% to 92.3% across 21 algorithms; ungradable rate ranged 0% to 28.2%.
links.quote: The AI algorithms achieved a mean agreement of 79.4% for referable DR, but the results varied from 49.4% to 92.3%.

screen.reason: Empirical head-to-head comparison of 21 AI algorithms on a prospectively collected dataset of handheld fundus photos to evaluate diagnostic accuracy and ungradable image rates.
